title.narrative: TOURLINK - Moving Thai Tourism towards sustainability through a business led supply chain approach

description.narrative: Specific objective: Thai tourism is more sustainable having adopted and replicated proven SCP practices, developed greener products, integrated MSMEs, and has obtained competitive advantages within the global tourism market which is supported by enabling government policies. It serves as a model for the region.
